answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 21586 Country: India Title: I have been a sunni muslim throughout my life, but now I have started doubting Sahih Muslim and Sahih Bukhari Hadeeths. Though I have strong faith in Quran. ->Is it important to believe in Sahih Hadiths to be a true Muslim. Your answer is very important for me Question: Assalamo Alaikum, Sir, I have been a sunni muslim throughout my life, but now I have started doubting Sahih Muslim and Sahih Bukhari Hadeeths. Though I have strong faith in Quran. ->Is it important to believe in Sahih Hadiths to be a true Muslim. Your answer is very important for me ! Allah Hafiz Answer ID: 21586 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 667/440/L=1431) Yes, for a true Muslim it is necessary to have faith on the sahih ahadith. To consider the collection of hadith totally unreliable or have doubt about them is a belief of kufr . You should do tauba and istighfar wholeheartedly and truly as well as recite la haul ( لا حول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ ) and durood extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
